description: Defines data schemas for an OEE monitoring system using Pydantic models, including classes for lines, shifts, runs, events, alerts, and reports.

classes.name: LineCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new production line with a unique name and target OEE ratio.

classes.name: LineOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting line information, including ID, name, and target OEE.

classes.name: ShiftCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a shift, including line ID, name, start and end timestamps.

classes.name: ShiftOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting shift details, including ID, line ID, name, and timestamps.

classes.name: RunCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a production run with associated line, shift, product, cycle time, and start time.

classes.name: RunEnd
classes.description: Schema for marking the end of a run with an end timestamp.

classes.name: RunOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting run details, including IDs, timestamps, and production parameters.

classes.name: EventCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating an event (production, downtime, quality) with relevant details.

classes.name: OEEOut
classes.description: Schema for representing OEE metrics and related counts.

classes.name: AlertOut
classes.description: Schema for alert details including severity, message, and timestamps.

classes.name: AlertAcknowledge
classes.description: Schema for acknowledging an alert with timestamp.

classes.name: ReportOut
classes.description: Schema for reporting OEE, alerts, and summary for a specific time window.
